welcome-to-dopamine: Welcome to Dopamine, we think you'll love it! First, let's set things up.
what-should-dopamine-look-like: What should your Dopamine look like?
let-us-set-up-collection: Let's now set up your collection. Where do you store your music?
let-us-start-dopamine: All done. Let's now start up Dopamine!
network-folder-url: This is a network address, not a folder. Connect to the share first (map it to a drive letter on Windows, or mount it on Linux), then add the folder it gives you.
network-folder-not-a-path: This is not a full folder path. Type the whole path, for example \\192.168.1.10\music, Z:\music or /mnt/music.
network-folder-unreachable-confirm: '{{folderPath}}' cannot be reached right now. Add it anyway? Its songs will appear once it can be reached.
folders-unreachable: Could not reach {{folders}}. Its {{numberOfSongs}} songs are kept and come back when it can be reached.
song-unreachable-skipped: This song cannot be reached right now (network folder offline?). Playing the next one.
songs-unreachable-stopped: Several songs in a row cannot be reached (network folder offline?). Playback stopped.
no-folders-in-collection: There are no folders in your collection
use-system-title-bar: Use system title bar (requires a restart)
show-welcome-screen-on-next-restart: Show the welcome screen on the next restart
show-album-cover-in-discord-description: Discord can only show covers from the internet, so the album title and artist are sent to Last.fm to find the cover.
show-album-art-on-dock-icon: Show album art on dock icon
about-this-version-text: This is an unofficial version of Dopamine by ApoloxDragon, with extra features such as CUE sheet albums, listening statistics and a parametric equalizer. It is based on Dopamine by Digimezzo.
thanks-to-sharlee: To Sharlee, for his gorgeous icons!
thanks-to-developers: To the developers who created the components which we use.
thanks-to-neowin: To Neowin for their great ideas, testing and bug reports.
add-folders-with-your-music: Add folders containing your music to your collection
show-all-folders-in-the-collection: Show all folders in the collection
skip-previously-removed-files: Skip files which were previously removed from the collection
fast-refresh-description: Looks only at songs that were added, changed or removed. Quick.
full-refresh-description: Reads every song again, also the ones that did not change. Use it after an update that improves how songs are read. Takes longer.
refresh-all-covers: Refresh covers for all albums, including those that already have a cover.
refresh-missing-covers: Refresh covers only for albums that have no cover yet.
refresh-all-artist-images: Refresh images for all artists, including those that already have an image.
refresh-missing-artist-images: Refresh images only for artists that have no image yet.
confirm-delete-folder-long: Are you sure you want to delete the folder '{{folderPath}}'?
delete-folder-error: An error occurred while deleting the folder. Please verify the log if you need more information.
get-folders-error: An error occurred while getting the folders. Please verify the log if you need more information.
add-folder-error: An error occurred while adding the folder. Please verify the log if you need more information.
global-error: An error has occurred which will cause the application to close. Please verify the log if you need more information.
create-playlist-folder-error: An error occurred while creating the playlist folder. Please verify the log if you need more information.
confirm-delete-playlist-folder-long: Are you sure you want to delete the playlist folder '{{playlistFolderName}}'? All its playlists will be lost.
delete-playlist-folder-error: An error occurred while deleting the playlist folder. Please verify the log if you need more information.
rename-playlist-folder-error: An error occurred while renaming the playlist folder. Please verify the log if you need more information.
confirm-delete-playlist-long: Are you sure you want to delete the playlist '{{playlistName}}'?
delete-playlist-error: An error occurred while deleting the playlist. Please verify the log if you need more information.
confirm-remove-from-playlist-long: Are you sure you want to remove these songs from the playlist?
remove-from-playlist-error: An error occurred while removing songs from the playlist. Please verify the log if you need more information.
online-preferences: Please tell us your online preferences.
show-icon-in-notification-area: Show an icon in the notification area (requires a restart)
delete-songs-error: An error occurred while deleting songs. Please verify the log if you need more information.
cue-tracks-cannot-be-edited: Songs from a CUE sheet album cannot be edited: they share one audio file with the rest of the album.
save-rating-error: An error occurred while saving the rating. Please verify the log if you need more information.
save-rating-to-audio-files: Save the rating to the audio files (MP3 only)
playlist-folder-is-empty: This playlist folder is empty. Don't forget to create some playlists.
title: Title
statistics-description: Only time that is actually playing counts. A song counts as a play after half of it, or 4 minutes. Everything stays on this computer.
no-listening-history: Nothing listened to yet in this period. Play some music and it will show up here.
confirm-clear-listening-history: Are you sure you want to delete your whole listening history, for all periods? This cannot be undone. Your songs and their play counts are not affected.
detailed-statistics-description: Also records how songs end (finished or skipped), how far you got and which parts you heard. Everything stays on this computer.
detailed-statistics-empty: Nothing recorded with detailed statistics in this period yet. Play some music and it will show up here.
listenbrainz-love-feedback-not-supported: ListenBrainz Love/Dislike feedback is currently not supported by Dopamine.
sleep-timer-end-of-song: Stop at the end of this song
sleep-timer-end-of-song-active: Sleep timer: stops at the end of this song
smart-shuffle-description: Shuffle favours songs you like and rate highly, plays disliked songs last, and avoids the same artist or album twice in a row.
continuous-play-description: When the queue ends, keep playing similar songs from your library (same artists, genres or years, liked songs first, disliked songs never). Added songs are marked in the queue.
show-love: Show the like and dislike buttons
save-love-error: An error occurred while saving 'Love'. Please verify the log if you need more information.
something-wrong-look-in-log-file: Did something go wrong? Have a look in the log file.
downloading-of-artist-information-from-l: Downloading of artist information from Last.fm is currently disabled. You can enable it here or in the settings.
keep-playback-controls-visible-on-now-pl: Keep playback controls visible on now playing page
albums-defined-by-folders-on-computer: Albums are defined by their folders on your computer
albums-defined-by-tag-album-title: Albums are defined by the 'Album' tag
albums-defined-by-tags-album-title-and-a: Albums are defined by the 'Album' and 'Album Artist' tags
changing-will-trigger-album-cover-refres: Changing this option will trigger a refresh of your album covers
remember-playback-state-after-restart: Remember playback state (queue, progress, loop, shuffle) after restart
add-symbol-error: An error occurred while adding the symbol. Please verify the log if you need more information.
remove-symbol-error: An error occurred while removing the symbol. Please verify the log if you need more information.
add-artist-error: An error occurred while adding the artist. Please verify the log if you need more information.
remove-artist-error: An error occurred while removing the artist. Please verify the log if you need more information.
confirm-remove-symbol: Are you sure you want to remove the symbol '{{symbol}}'?
confirm-remove-artist: Are you sure you want to remove the artist '{{artist}}'?
thanks-to-visualisationexpo: To VisualisationExpo, for the superb macOS icon!
enable-fade-on-pause: Fade out when pausing or stopping, fade in when resuming
use-separate-fade-in-duration: Use a separate fade in duration
fade-on-pause-description: From 1 ms to 60 s. The pause shows at once; the music fades out and then pauses. Pressing play during a fade brings the music back from where the fade is.
edit-tracks-selection-message: You selected {{count}} songs. The changes will affect all selected songs.
read-tags-error-single-file: An error occurred while reading the tags of 1 file. Please check the log file if you need more information.
read-tags-error-multiple-files: An error occurred while reading the tags of {{numberOfFiles}} files. Please check the log file if you need more information.
save-tags-error-single-file: An error occurred while saving the tags of 1 file. Please check the log file if you need more information.
save-tags-error-multiple-files: An error occurred while saving the tags of {{numberOfFiles}} files. Please check the log file if you need more information.
change-image-error: An error occurred while changing the image. Please check the log file if you need more information.
download-image-error: An error occurred while downloading the image. Please check the log file if you need more information.
no-image-found-online: No image could be found online.
no-images-found-online: No images could be found online.
cannot-play-m4a-file: The M4A file cannot be played. Please note that Dopamine supports only AAC-encoded M4A files and does not support Apple ALAC-encoded M4A files. Please check the log file if you need more information.
cannot-play-audio-file: The selected audio file cannot be played. Please check the log file if you need more information.
confirm-delete-song: Are you sure you want to delete this song? It will be moved to the trash if possible, otherwise it will be permanently deleted.
confirm-delete-songs: Are you sure you want to delete these songs? They will be moved to the trash if possible, otherwise they will be permanently deleted.
show-refresh-notification-at-startup: Show a refresh notification at startup
refresh-replaygain-existing-tracks: Refresh ReplayGain metadata for existing songs only
replaygain-log-at-track-start: Log ReplayGain correction at track start
show-album-on-now-playing-page: Show album on now playing page
replaygain-requires-tags: ReplayGain only works when your files already contain ReplayGain tags.
replaygain-scan-tags-external-tool: Scan your files first with an external tool such as
restore-ratings-from-backup-description: Restore ratings and love from the backup file for songs that have no rating yet.
compact-tracklist-view: Compact song list view (hide song artists)
equalizer-import-result: Imported {{bands}} bands. {{skipped}} lines could not be read.
equalizer-import-graphic-result: Fitted the GraphicEQ curve ({{points}} points) to the 10-band graphic equalizer. It differs from the file by {{rms}} dB on average and at most {{max}} dB (at {{frequency}}). Narrow details need the parametric version of the file.
equalizer-import-tooltip: AutoEQ ParametricEQ.txt or GraphicEQ.txt, or an Equalizer APO file
equalizer-import-nothing-found: No equalizer settings were found in this file. Use an AutoEQ ParametricEQ.txt or GraphicEQ.txt file, or an Equalizer APO file.
equalizer-export-done: Exported in the AutoEQ / Equalizer APO format.
equalizer-may-clip: Boosts of up to {{peak}} dB can make loud music distort. Set the preamp to {{preamp}} dB or lower.
equalizer-parametric-hint: Drag a handle to change frequency and gain. Scroll over a handle to change Q.
equalizer-shelf-q: Shelf filters use a fixed slope (Q 0.71)
show-year-on-now-playing-page: Show year on now playing page
use-thick-progress-and-volume-bars: Use thick progress bars, volume bars and toggle switches.
sort-prefixes: Prefixes to ignore when sorting artists
confirm-remove-prefix: Are you sure you want to remove '{{prefix}}'?
playlist-session-available: A playback session was started for this playlist
playlist-changed-since-last-session: This playlist has changed since the last session. Playback will start from the beginning.
